decisions.source_evidence: Panel 0-1, line 4 (start of the line: אשר־שמתי בפיך לא ימוש). Under the shin there is a patah, and a separate short vertical stroke sits at its left end, before the mem with sheva. It is not part of the patah bar. Matches restored שַֽׂמְתִּי.

decisions.host: between י (qamats) and מ, so on מ per restored form
decisions.source_evidence: Panel 0-0, line 4 (start of the line: ימושו מפיך ומפי זרעך). A separate short vertical stroke hangs below the baseline just left of the qamats under the yod, under the mem. The same word at the end of panel 0-1 line 4 (לא ימוש, the previous instance) shows a similar stroke. Host flag: the stroke sits on the boundary between yod and mem. The restored placement on מ (יָמֽוּשׁוּ) fits the print, but the exact host letter is a judgement call.

Panel 2-1, line 3 (יקרה: ותשאני רוח ואשמע). Below the alef, next to the two tsere dots, there is a short vertical stroke separate from the dots. Matches restored וַתִּשָּׂאֵֽנִי. At this resolution I cannot confirm the dagesh in the shin.

Panel 2-0, line 4 (: ונטלתני רוחא ושמעת בתרי). Under the lamed there is a patah plus a separate short vertical stroke at its left, before the tav with sheva. It is distinct from the qamats under the tet. Matches restored וּנְטָלַֽתְנִי.

Panel 2-1, line 6 (קל זיע סגיא דמשבחין). Under the zayin, besides the hiriq dot, there is a short vertical stroke reaching below the baseline. It is not a smudge: its width and weight match the other metegs. Matches restored זִֽיעַ.
Panel 4-0, line 5 (לאבתינו מימי קדם: ברוך). Under the first mem there is a hiriq dot plus a separate short vertical stroke. The second mem has only the tsere dots. Matches restored מִֽימֵי.

unresolved: id 79: the stroke is clearly there, but whether it belongs to the yod or the mem is borderline in the print. The restored form puts it on the mem.
